name: Intelligent Job Search Pipeline
description: DAG-based parallel job search with dependency resolution

tasks.prompt: Search for software engineering jobs posted in last 24 hours. Use web search to find 10+ opportunities. Return job title, company, location, and application link for each.

For each job from the search results, visit the company career page and verify: 1) Job is actually posted, 2) Requirements match entry-to-mid level, 3) Location is suitable. Return verified jobs with confirmation details.
Filter verified jobs to remove duplicates and already-applied companies. Compare against tracker data. Return unique jobs worth applying to.
Analyze job description for job 1. Extract: required skills, nice-to-have skills, company tech stack, role expectations. Return structured analysis.
Analyze job description for job 2. Extract: required skills, nice-to-have skills, company tech stack, role expectations. Return structured analysis.
Analyze job description for job 3. Extract: required skills, nice-to-have skills, company tech stack, role expectations. Return structured analysis.
Using the base resume and JD analysis for job 1, create a tailored one-page LaTeX resume. Match location, prioritize relevant skills, rewrite professional summary. Return complete .tex file.
Using the base resume and JD analysis for job 2, create a tailored one-page LaTeX resume. Match location, prioritize relevant skills, rewrite professional summary. Return complete .tex file.
Using the base resume and JD analysis for job 3, create a tailored one-page LaTeX resume. Match location, prioritize relevant skills, rewrite professional summary. Return complete .tex file.
Compile all tailored .tex resumes to PDF using pdflatex. Verify each is exactly one page. Clean up auxiliary files. Confirm PDF generation success.
Update job search tracker CSV with all companies and roles from verified jobs. Ensure no duplicates. Confirm tracking update.

Send comprehensive email to praju9rt@gmail.com with: 1) Verified job list with links, 2) Tailored resume PDFs as attachments, 3) Application guidance per job, 4) Tracker confirmation. Use send_email_to_user tool.
